run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate a GIF from a trajectory file
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelize_generation to render POV-Ray images and create a GIF from a trajectory file using multiple processes
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms to render a single POV-Ray snapshot image from an ASE atoms object with bond pairs
review_pov_from_atoms: review the pov_from_atoms function that separates organic adsorbate atoms from surface atoms and renders POV-Ray images
review_parallelize_generation: review the parallelize_generation function that reads trajectory files, parallelizes image rendering, and creates a GIF with ffmpeg
